selection_rule: use every pre-frozen numeric seed 0 through 29 for each category; selection is independent of generation status and evaluation results
failure_policy: retain terminal timeout, missing package, invalid tree, parse failure, and unscorable cases in the requested denominator without replacement
oven_boundary: OvenFactory is excluded because the common correctness category is microwave. Historical oven structure results must not be relabeled as microwave.

evaluation.role_assignment: join package-local data_infos_<seed>.json file_name to each URDF visual mesh basename; package labels are prediction-side only

claim_boundary: package-level structural validity and PartNet-ontology-referenced induced semantic-parent alignment proxy; not instance-level kinematic correctness
